_note: Năm style artwork được phép cho dự án mới. P1 phải chọn đúng một style trong danh sách này; code ưu tiên style ít dùng hơn khi các phương án có chất lượng tương đương.

families.name: Styled photography
families.description: photorealistic editorial still lifes or environments with believable materials and natural light; no illustrated or painterly treatment

families.name: Layered papercut
families.description: clearly cut paper layers, tactile edges and controlled cast shadows; contemporary dimensional collage

families.name: Mid-century poster
families.description: bold 1950s-60s poster geometry, simplified silhouettes and restrained screenprint texture

families.name: Anime illustration
families.description: original Japanese-animation-inspired illustration: clean confident line art, flat cel shading with one soft shadow tone, expressive simplified shapes and luminous hand-painted backgrounds with clear skies and soft natural light; original subjects and settings only, never resembling any existing series, film, studio style or character

families.name: Cinematic film still
families.description: photoreal frame from an original live-action film: a story moment caught mid-scene with motivated, directional key light, shallow depth of field, deliberate lens choice and subtle film grain; lighting and color grade chosen to fit each scene's story, always clear and readable; original characters and settings only, never resembling any existing film, actor or franchise; differs from styled photography by telling a narrative moment rather than showing a styled arrangement
